trends.name: Iran Military Escalation & War Risk
trends.summary: Two U.S. combat aircraft downed/crashed in Persian Gulf region near Strait of Hormuz; Trump threatens Iranian infrastructure destruction; Iran rejects 48-hour ceasefire proposal. Direct military escalation signals elevated geopolitical risk and potential supply chain disruption, particularly for oil markets and defense contractors.

trends.name: Oil & Energy Markets Surge on War Premium
trends.summary: Wall Street rotating into oil-and-gas producers amid Iran conflict; traders loading up on lagging energy stocks as disruption fears mount; Strait of Hormuz closure risks trigger broad commodity reassessment. Energy sector fundamentals now driven by geopolitical risk rather than demand alone.

trends.name: U.S. Jobs Data Beats But Inflation Concerns Rise
trends.summary: March nonfarm payrolls added 178,000 jobs (better-than-expected), unemployment steady at 4.3%; jobs gains in healthcare, construction, transportation. However, strong labor data combined with Iran war adds to inflation fears, complicating Fed rate-cut expectations and triggering Treasury yield uptick.

trends.name: Federal Debt & Interest Payment Crisis
trends.summary: U.S. net interest payments surging: $882B (2024) → $970B (2025) → $1T+ (2026 projected); unsustainable trajectory crimps fiscal flexibility and crowds out productive spending. Central banks forced to sell gold reserves to raise cash; long-term bond market pressure mounting.

trends.name: Retirement Account Stress & Hardship Withdrawals Spike
trends.summary: Record 6% of retirement plan holders requested hardship withdrawals in 2025 (up from 4.8% in 2024, vs. 2% pre-pandemic). Signals financial distress among savers; inflationary pressure, housing costs, and economic uncertainty forcing early liquidations and penalizing long-term retirement security.

trends.name: Healthcare System & Medicare Advantage Crisis
trends.summary: 'Overlooked catastrophe' as major hospitals refuse Medicare Advantage coverage for cancer patients, forcing plan holders into out-of-pocket costs. Exposes structural failures in privatized Medicare model; potential catalyst for regulatory intervention and sector-wide insurer repricing.

trends.name: Tech Giants Face Section 230 Legal Challenges
trends.summary: Meta and Google under court attack as litigators bypass 30-year-old Section 230 legal shield that protected platform immunity. Landmark cases signal end of content liability immunity era; could force massive compliance spending and liability repricing across Big Tech.

trends.name: AI-Driven Sector Rotation & Salesforce Upside
trends.summary: Salesforce upgraded to Buy on agentic AI monetization potential and Rule of 44 outperformance; broader AI infrastructure beneficiary narrative driving software/SaaS revaluation. OpenAI leadership changes (Fidji Simo medical leave) inject uncertainty into enterprise AI deployment timeline.

trends.name: Housing Market Buyer Leverage Shift
trends.summary: Buyer leverage finally returning as housing inventory increases and price growth moderates; opportunity to negotiate down from asking prices. Combined with strong jobs data and modest Treasury yields, creates window for first-time homebuyers before rates reset.

trends.name: Treasury & Currency Markets React to Rate Expectations
trends.summary: USD/JPY under pressure as markets price in potential BoJ rate hike; Treasury yields climbed modestly post-March jobs data. Currency volatility and yield curve repricing creating FX trading opportunities; safe-haven flows toward U.S. assets amid Iran crisis.

trends.name: Satellite & Chip Innovation Supply Chain
trends.summary: SpaceX and Amazon satellite mega-projects driving demand for specialized semiconductor supply; little-known chip stocks emerging as underappreciated beneficiaries. Complements Iran supply-chain anxiety with long-term tech infrastructure thesis.

trends.name: Consumer Labor Market Deterioration Risks
trends.summary: Despite job gains, 'show me a desk' not 'show me the money' labor sentiment signals wage stagnation and gig-ification of workforce. AI displacement fears intensifying (jobs vanishing in a month narrative); income inequality and job security concerns dampen consumer spending outlook.
